columns.name: video_id
columns.meaning: YouTube video ID. The video is at youtube.com/watch?v=<video_id>.

columns.name: channel_id
columns.meaning: YouTube channel ID of the uploader.

columns.name: channel_title
columns.meaning: The channel's display name.

columns.name: published_at
columns.meaning: When the video was published.

columns.name: title
columns.meaning: Video title.
columns.how: videos.list snippet.title, as first collected. See title_changed.

columns.name: tags
columns.meaning: Uploader's tags, separated by |. Empty when the video has none.

columns.name: category_id
columns.meaning: YouTube category number.

columns.name: category_name
columns.meaning: YouTube category name.
columns.how: Looked up from YouTube's category list for Sri Lanka. That list leaves out category 29, which we fill in as Nonprofits & Activism.

columns.name: duration_seconds
columns.meaning: Length in seconds. Empty when YouTube reports no usable duration.

columns.name: is_short
columns.meaning: Whether the video is a YouTube Short.
columns.how: The API has no Shorts flag. True when the player is vertical or square and the video is at most 180 seconds. Where the player shape is unknown (is_vertical empty), true when the video is at most 60 seconds.

columns.name: is_vertical
columns.meaning: Whether the video player is taller than or as tall as it is wide. Empty when the shape could not be read.
columns.how: Embed width and height from YouTube's oEmbed endpoint.

columns.name: is_live_broadcast
columns.meaning: Whether the video is a live broadcast (YouTube reports its duration as zero).

columns.name: definition
columns.meaning: hd or sd.

columns.name: caption
columns.meaning: Whether the uploader added captions.

columns.name: made_for_kids
columns.meaning: Whether the video is marked as made for kids.

columns.name: default_audio_language
columns.meaning: Spoken language the uploader set, as a language code. Often empty.

columns.name: default_language
columns.meaning: Language of the title and description the uploader set, as a language code.

columns.name: description_length
columns.meaning: Number of characters in the description. 0 when there is none.
columns.how: Length of videos.list snippet.description. The description itself is not included.

columns.name: topic_categories
columns.meaning: The channel's topics, as Wikipedia URLs separated by |.

columns.name: ch_subs_at_publish
columns.group: Channel when the video was published
columns.meaning: Channel subscribers.
columns.how: From our channel snapshot taken at or most recently before published_at.

columns.name: ch_views_at_publish
columns.group: Channel when the video was published
columns.meaning: Channel total views.

columns.name: ch_videos_at_publish
columns.group: Channel when the video was published
columns.meaning: Number of videos on the channel.

columns.name: channel_age_days_at_publish
columns.group: Channel when the video was published
columns.meaning: Days between the channel's creation and the video's publication.

columns.name: ch_stats_as_of
columns.group: Channel when the video was published
columns.meaning: When the channel snapshot above was taken.
columns.how: If it is after published_at, no snapshot predated the video and the earliest one was used instead, so the channel figures include some growth after publication.

columns.name: d7_views
columns.meaning: Total views at day 7.
columns.how: From our poll nearest to 168 hours after published_at.

columns.name: d7_likes
columns.meaning: Total likes at day 7. Empty when likes are hidden.

columns.name: d7_comments
columns.meaning: Total comments at day 7. Empty when comments are off.

columns.name: d7_hours_off
columns.meaning: How far that poll was from the exact day-7 mark, in hours. Positive means after the mark.
columns.how: Poll time minus (published_at + 168 hours). Use the day-7 figures only when this is within ±12 and d7_views is present.

columns.name: d14_views
columns.meaning: Total views at day 14.
columns.how: From our poll nearest to 336 hours after published_at.

columns.name: d14_likes
columns.meaning: Total likes at day 14. Empty when likes are hidden.

columns.name: d14_comments
columns.meaning: Total comments at day 14. Empty when comments are off.

columns.name: d14_hours_off
columns.meaning: How far that poll was from the exact day-14 mark, in hours. Positive means after the mark.
columns.how: Poll time minus (published_at + 336 hours). Use the day-14 figures only when this is within ±12 and d14_views is present.

columns.name: d21_views
columns.meaning: Total views at day 21.
columns.how: From our poll nearest to 504 hours after published_at.

columns.name: d21_likes
columns.meaning: Total likes at day 21. Empty when likes are hidden.

columns.name: d21_comments
columns.meaning: Total comments at day 21. Empty when comments are off.

columns.name: d21_hours_off
columns.meaning: How far that poll was from the exact day-21 mark, in hours. Positive means after the mark.
columns.how: Poll time minus (published_at + 504 hours). Use the day-21 figures only when this is within ±12 and d21_views is present.

columns.name: d30_views
columns.meaning: Total views at day 30.
columns.how: From our poll nearest to 720 hours after published_at.

columns.name: d30_likes
columns.meaning: Total likes at day 30. Empty when likes are hidden.

columns.name: d30_comments
columns.meaning: Total comments at day 30. Empty when comments are off.

columns.name: d30_hours_off
columns.meaning: How far that poll was from the exact day-30 mark, in hours. Positive means after the mark.
columns.how: Poll time minus (published_at + 720 hours). Use the day-30 figures only when this is within ±12 and d30_views is present.

columns.name: title_changed
columns.meaning: Whether a later poll saw a different title from the one in this file.

columns.name: description_changed
columns.meaning: Whether a later poll saw a different description.
columns.how: Compared by fingerprint on every poll.
